narration.text: Murf costs five times more. Is it worth it?

First, transcription! Descript lets you edit audio just by editing text, offering incredible accuracy. Murf, on the other hand, is purely text-to-speech, with no direct transcription feature. No contest here!
Next up, voice cloning! Descript offers voice cloning from its Creator plan upwards. Murf reserves this for its Enterprise plan, with custom pricing. Ouch, that one hurts the budget!
So, Descript is the clear champion for podcasters, offering powerful audio editing and transcription. Murf is still good for text-to-speech without existing audio. Which one would you pick?
